name: The Kilnway
unique_feature: a mouth of black rock breathing warm air onto the ash heath, cracks at its lip still red
story: The Builders cut roads through the living rock of the ash country, and where the fire under it had already made a road they used that one. The Kilnway is a lava tube they paved and walked. After the Ash Winter the fire came back into it, a little, and something the Tolling Order sent down to keep it has been keeping it ever since.
encounter: ash-wights along the tube, choristers on the ledges, and the Kiln-Warden in the old toll-hall at the bottom
hook: A pilgrim's cairn at the mouth, and under its top stone a note in the Order's hand asking whoever reads it to go down and ring the Warden to rest.

name: Scathe Fort
unique_feature: a square Warden fort on the open down, its gate hanging open and smoke going up from inside it again
story: Scathe was a Warden fort for the down's roads when the downs had roads worth keeping. The Wardens left it when the Rest could no longer pay a garrison. This spring a crew of Larkbourne bruisers moved in, lit the yard fire, and started taking a tithe off anything that crosses the down.
encounter: bandits on the walls and in the yard, archers on the corner towers, their captain in the keep's undercroft
hook: A notice nailed at the gate in a Warden's hand, offering the fort's old bounty to whoever clears it, and a second notice under it in a worse hand saying the tithe has gone up.

site.hook_prompt: Read the notices on the gate
